titles: 美国超能力部队SCION最强者

status.current: approaching the ruined Rebellion headquarters in armed helicopters

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: His approach threatens Kozo's attempt to rebuild Rebellion as a third force.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: His arrival signals the world crisis Tsukikage feared may accelerate.

periods.summary: Abraham Carter does not appear in person, but a Rebellion lookout reports that three armed Albatross helicopters are approaching the headquarters at triple catalog speed, identifying the intruders as America's SCION unit led by the Union's strongest man, the Superman Abraham Carter. His immediate move toward the ruined Rebellion base suggests the Union is acting before Rebellion can recover, confirming Kozo's sense that the world order is shifting beyond his control.

key_events.summary: His armed helicopters approach Rebellion headquarters after Tsukikage's investigation.

periods.time: Two weeks before the final narration, at the ruined Rebellion headquarters in the Alps
periods.label: 从天而降质问世界阵营的美国超人

name.jp: アブラハム・カーター

periods.affiliation: United States; PSYON; Great Powers/Union side implied

status.current: arrives at ruined Rebellion HQ with American troops and confronts Bakuya Tsukikage and Kozo Kazamatsuri
status.goal: determine whether Japan's prime minister and Kazamatsuri Group will stand as enemies or allies of the United States/world order

personality.summary: Impassive and authoritative, speaking as if he represents world justice rather than an individual nation.
values: world justice as defined by the States

abilities_owned: flight or slow aerial descent without parachute

relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Confronts the Japanese prime minister and asks his allegiance after Rebellion's fall.
relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Confronts the Kazamatsuri Group president alongside Tsukikage.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Rinna wants to defend her father but Kozo warns she cannot beat Abraham.
relationships.charlotte-corday: One of the defenders Kozo orders not to fight him.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: One of the defenders Kozo orders not to fight him.

periods.summary: In the epilogue, after Or-Gaule's destruction of Rebellion collapses the old three-way balance among League, Union and Rebellion, American PSYON forces descend on the ruined Rebellion headquarters in the Alps. Abraham Carter, PSYON's captain and the United States' strongest psychic, drops from a helicopter without a parachute and descends more slowly than soldiers using parachutes. Kozo Kazamatsuri identifies him as too strong for Rinna, Charlotte and Sara to oppose. Abraham lands before Kozo and Japanese Prime Minister Bakuya Tsukikage, names them, and asks on behalf of the United States and world justice whether they are enemies or allies and which side they belong to.

key_events.summary: Arrives with PSYON troops and demands Japan/Kazamatsuri choose a side.

periods.time: From the Alps operation through the Japanese invasion

name.jp: アブラハム・カーター

titles: 合众国最强超能力者的量产体
periods.species: Magic Creature clone / Blazer / Tyrant-DNA copy

status.current: many clones are destroyed in Europe and Japan, but at least one clone assists Arlanz in abducting Stella
status.condition: individual units are expendable, obedient and partly devoid of ordinary selfhood

relationships.carl-arlanz: Creator and commander; all clones obey him and share information through telepathy.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Former hidden opponent who once traumatized Ouma; one clone loses to Ouma's perfected wind sword before massed clones overwhelm him.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Fights Nango in Europe and later loses many units to his Kotodama and Otogiri.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: The PSYON army forces her into her Three Thousand Worlds time-loop awakening.
relationships.douglas-upton: Serves as the second-wave ground breakthrough that lets Upton attempt to destroy Tokyo.

periods.summary: Abraham Carter first appears as the commander who restrains Kazamatsuri's group and exposes the dead Tyrant. He uses mental control to interrogate Tsukikage and Kazamatsuri, then fights Ouma at the Tatra base with a terrifying suite of powers. The volume reveals that 'Abraham Carter' is not a single person but Arlanz's mass-produced Tyrant-DNA clone line: PSYON consists entirely of Abrahams linked by telepathy. Their teleportation, precognition, psychokinesis, hypnosis, pyrokinesis and electrokinesis break Japan's first defensive line and nearly decide the war until Kurono repeatedly rewrites the same time interval to defeat them. Later units guard the Tyrant hangar and one self-destructs to stop Ikki during Stella's abduction.

key_events.summary: Controls Kazamatsuri's group and helps seize the Tyrant's corpse.
One clone duels Ouma with multiple psychic abilities; many clones then reveal PSYON's true nature.
PSYON clones teleport past Japanese defenses and open the way for EDY and Upton's strike.
Hundreds of clones are countered when Kurono awakens time-loop intervention.
A clone ambushes Stella and self-destructs while restraining Ikki.

name.jp: アブラハム・カーター系列

periods.affiliation: Karl Eilands' laboratories; formerly US special ability forces

personality.summary: The Abraham units are powerful but lack true ego. They act mechanically, share information by telepathy and therefore cannot grow into true Desperados, which Eilands identifies as the Abraham Project's failure.

relationships.karl-eilands: Creator and operator who regards them as failed but useful tools.
relationships.stella-vermillion: One unit performs deep brain interference to erase her personality.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Fights him and Touka on the fourth floor; prior data from Ouma is shared among units.
relationships.toka-todo: Cuts one unit down with Raikiri using laboratory electricity.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Injures him but is temporarily restrained by Shadow Bind.

periods.summary: Vol-21 clarifies the Abraham Project: Eilands created Abraham Carter clones using cell magic and Tyrant-derived power, but they lack ego and thus cannot grow into true Desperados. In the Nikko lab, one Abraham uses Gospel and Mind Control, aided by drugs and machinery, to rewrite Stella's memories and delete her personality. Five more units are activated as defenders. They ambush the rescue team with teleportation and psychic attacks, injuring Touka and Alice, but Ouma, Touka and Alice remain behind to contain them. Touka destroys one with Raikiri; the others are fought down while Ikki and Shizuku proceed to Stella.

key_events.summary: An Abraham unit uses Gospel and Mind Control to interfere with Stella's brain.
Five Abraham defenders ambush the rescue team and are held by Ouma, Touka and Alice.
The operating Abraham is destroyed by Shizuku's Akabeni Rikka fragments when Stella's tank breaks.
